info.title: SQLDiff
info.description: Command-line schema diff and sync for SQL Server: extract a schema, compare two databases, and apply data-preserving ALTER scripts inside one transaction.

x-inspectra.cliParsedTitle: SQLDiff 1.5.0 - SQL Server schema diff and sync (.NET 9

commands.name: apply
commands.description:
Run an existing script against a database.
--conn <cs> --script <diff.sql> [--dry-run]
[--timeout-seconds 120] [--no-transaction] [--log apply.log]

commands.name: check-conn
commands.description:
Verify connectivity and print server metadata.
(--conn <cs> | --source-conn <cs> [--target-conn <cs>])
[--timeout-seconds 15]

commands.name: deploy
commands.description:
diff + apply in one step (always applies).
delta-apply is an alias.

commands.name: diff
commands.description:
Compare source against target and write the migration SQL.
(--source-conn <cs> | --source-snapshot <json>)
(--target-conn <cs> | --target-snapshot <json>)
[--out diff.sql] [--include-drops] [--include-table-drops]
[--allow-table-rebuild] [--add-only]

commands.name: drift
commands.description:
Same as diff, but exits with code 2 when anything differs.
Defaults --include-drops and --include-table-drops to true.

commands.name: extract
commands.description:
Script a database and optionally save a JSON snapshot.
--conn <cs> [--out schema.sql] [--json snapshot.json]

commands.name: SQLDIFF_CONN
commands.description:
Used when no option is given.
The same three forms exist for both sides: --source-conn / --source-conn-file /
SQLDIFF_SOURCE_CONN and --target-conn / --target-conn-file / SQLDIFF_TARGET_CONN.
Prefer Integrated Security on Windows; a password passed as an argument is
visible to other processes and is recorded in shell history.

commands.name: sync
commands.description:
Same as diff, and applies it when --apply is given.
... [--apply] [--dry-run] [--timeout-seconds 120]
[--no-transaction] [--log apply.log]

commands.name: version
commands.description: Print the version. --version and -v also work.
